import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import io
from io import StringIO

# Load the dataset
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import io
from io import StringIO

# Load the dataset
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Convert hour_of_day to categorical variable
df['hour_of_day'] = pd.cut(df['hour_of_day'], 
                           bins=[0, 5, 12, 17, 21, 24], 
                           labels=['Early Morning', 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening', 'Night'])

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of transactions by hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=df)

# Set title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Transactions by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count of Transactions')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
